name: textarea
description: A multi-line text input for free-form prose. Built on the native HTML textarea element. Use for notes, comments, descriptions, and any content where the user needs more than one line.

notes: Textarea shares the input Figma component set (Type=Textarea). Separate tsx file: textarea.tsx.
footer > action is a primary Button instance — do not override internally.
Resize handle is native browser UI — not tokenised, cannot be styled.

Composed header/footer pattern: the wrapper owns the surface fill (color/input/bg); header, footer, and the textarea itself are transparent so the card reads as one continuous surface in both themes. Do not set color/background/default on header/footer — it matches in light mode but diverges in dark (zinc/950 vs zinc/700).

changelog.change: Composed header/footer stories (WithHeader, WithFooter, WithHeaderAndFooter): unified surface — wrapper now carries color/input/bg, header/footer and textarea are bg-transparent. Fixes dark-mode gray band (header/footer were color/background/default = zinc/950 vs body color/input/bg = zinc/700). Story-only; component tsx unchanged.
Invalid state: blue focus ring replaced with red ring using [&[aria-invalid]] compound selector. Prevents blue ring appearing on focused invalid field.

darkMode.notes: Container fill uses color/input/bg (Dark: zinc/700) — one step lighter than surface/overlay so the textarea stands out from the panel. Disabled fill uses color/surface/muted (Dark: zinc/800).

notes: Invalid+focused: [&[aria-invalid]] compound selector ensures red ring beats focus-visible specificity.
Native resize handle kept by default — only use resize-none when fixed height is strictly required.
Height: uncontrolled in code (user resizes). Figma shows 120px fixed for design reference only.

relatedComponents.name: input
relatedComponents.reason: Input is single-line; Textarea is multi-line. Same token set, different structure and height behavior.

relatedComponents.name: combobox
relatedComponents.reason: Use combobox (Filled-chips) instead of Textarea for structured multi-value entry (tags, emails).

relatedComponents.name: label
relatedComponents.reason: Label component wraps with input-field — required for accessibility.

requires: input-field wrapper for standard form use

input-field.purpose: Complete form field — label + textarea + description

focus.notes: color/border/focus stroke + ring glow at 20% opacity via color-mix

invalid.notes: Uses [&[aria-invalid]] compound selector to beat focus-visible specificity. Blue ring must NOT appear when invalid.

rules: Use input-field wrapper for all standard form use — never textarea standalone.
One trailing slot visible at a time — counter OR action OR trailing-icon.
footer.action is always a primary Button — do not override its fills.
Resize handle is native — do not suppress unless fixed height is required.

typeGuide.Default: Empty field awaiting input. Shows placeholder text.
typeGuide.Focused: User has clicked in. Blue border + ring glow. Enter inserts newline.
typeGuide.Filled: User has typed content. Value text replaces placeholder.
typeGuide.Invalid: Validation failed. Red border + red ring. Description shows specific error message.
typeGuide.Disabled: Non-interactive. Muted fill. No focus possible.

animation.description: No animation — native textarea renders immediately on focus.

behavior.scrollBehavior: internal scroll when content exceeds height (native browser behavior)

keyboardPattern.Tab: Move focus into / out of textarea

ariaAttributes.aria-labelledby: manual — via htmlFor/id pairing with label
ariaAttributes.aria-describedby: manual — via aria-describedby pointing to description element
ariaAttributes.aria-invalid: when applicable — marks field as invalid for screen readers

accessibility.screenReaderName: Derived from associated label via htmlFor/id pairing
accessibility.focusIndicator: color/border/focus 1px border + glow (valid) | color/border/error 1px border + red glow (invalid)
accessibility.touchTarget: No minimum — textarea fills its container width
requiredMarkup: label with htmlFor matching textarea id

storybook.title: Forms/Textarea
storybook.notes: Invalid+focus: red ring via [&[aria-invalid]] compound selector — verified 2026-06-03. Composed header/footer stories share one continuous color/input/bg surface (wrapper-filled; header/footer/textarea transparent) — verified light + dark 2026-06-17.

usage: Use input-field, not textarea standalone, for all standard form fields.
Use Textarea for free-form multi-line prose only.
Keep resize handle enabled unless fixed height is strictly required by layout.
doNot: Do not use Textarea for structured multi-value entry — use combobox (Filled-chips).
Do not use Textarea for single-line input — use Input.
Do not add resize-none by default — users need to expand notes and description fields.
Do not show multiple trailing slots simultaneously.
Do not use generic 'Invalid' description — write the specific error.
Do not override footer.action fills — change the Button Variant prop instead.

required: input-field when used in any form

useCases: Support ticket message field — long-form free text requiring multiple lines
Product description in a CMS — prose content with variable length
User bio on a profile settings page — typically 2–4 lines
Notes field on a record (contact, project, invoice) — open-ended annotation
Commit message input — header line with optional extended body
Address field when the full address is a single unstructured block

examples: Empty 'Notes' field on a new record
Typed commit message in a PR form

WithHeader.whenToUse: Formatting controls or section label needed above the text area

WithCharacterCount.whenToUse: Hard character limit the user needs to track

comparedTo.situation: Single-line text: name, email, search, number
Multiple tag-like values: emails, labels, recipients
Rich text with formatting (bold, lists, links)
